svg.title: Push 2 × Traktor four-deck cheat sheet
svg.text: Push 2 × Traktor Pro 4 — four-deck cheat sheet
push_quad.py + Push2 Bridge.tsi · each 4×4 corner of the pads is one deck
touch knobs 1–4 and turn to scratch · turn without touching to nudge
upper buttons: FX units on/off + buttons · lower buttons: send a deck to FX1 / FX2
Play: pulses on the beat while playing
Play flashes red: track is ending
Cue: hold to preview, CDJ style
Load: deck colour when a track is loaded
Drums · yellow Bass · cyan Other · magenta Vocals
Lit size = selected; pulses while looping
Tap the lit size again to exit the loop
1 Stems: mute drums / bass / other / vocals
Corners glowing dim in the deck colours = script running,
waiting for Traktor (check In/Out port: Push2 Traktor Bridge).
